name: just-draw-press
reply:
What I saw
- You asked to show the immediate pressure after losing possession in our possession-based model.

On the board
- Highlighted a counterpressing cluster with the nearest three attacking players swarming the ball carrier.
- Positioned the remaining unit to compact central spaces and deny forward progression.

Coaching points
- Apply an immediate organized counterpress for 3 to 5 seconds upon ball loss to win it back or force a negative touch.
- Ensure the nearest players step up aggressively while secondary defenders cover nearby passing lanes.
- If the ball is not won immediately, quickly recover compact distances to deny central progression.
